id: title:adboio:preserve routed provider in cost aliases

review.posthog_relevance: Supports the LLM Gateway subsystem, specifically the cost-refresh and model-registry components, by storing provider identity alongside canonical model aliases. This enables accurate cost attribution and provider-specific routing, though the tier is assigned based on the implementation of this bounded capability rather than unverified production outcomes.
review.reason: The change is a substantive, bounded improvement to the LLM Gateway's cost and model management. It refactors the `COST_ALIASES` dictionary to store both canonical identity and provider information, and updates the model registry to use this combined mapping. This supports accurate cost attribution and provider-specific behavior, which are critical for billing and routing. The tier
review.uncertainty: This score relies on the supplied observations. No independent verification of production adoption, incident avoidance, or actual benefit realization is available. The tier is assigned based on the implementation and relevance of the change, not on unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assignment is made; this is an unassessed contribution.

observations.behavior: The COST_ALIASES dictionary type and values are changed from a simple alias-to-canonical mapping to an alias-to-(canonical, provider) tuple. The aliasing and provider assignment are now stored together.
observations.posthog_connection: This change supports the LLM Gateway's cost-refresh and model-registry subsystems, allowing the gateway to distinguish the canonical model identity from the provider used for billing and routing, while retaining the original alias for compatibility.

observations.behavior: The apply_cost_aliases function now unpacks the tuple and copies the canonical cost while also assigning the provider to the alias entry.
observations.posthog_connection: This preserves the canonical cost and metadata while explicitly recording the provider associated with the aliased entry, supporting accurate cost attribution and provider-specific behavior.

observations.behavior: The model_registry module imports COST_ALIASES to use it in model availability checks.
observations.posthog_connection: This enables the model registry to use the alias-to-provider mapping when filtering available models, supporting the gateway's ability to exclude or include aliased models based on provider configuration.
